splitUnit: originating-template-family; all modality and near-duplicate variants stay together

confidenceInterval.primary: Exact per-family metric table and observed family min/max, with family counts by action; no population confidence interval or generalization guarantee from fifteen held-out families.
confidenceInterval.secondary: Nominal case-level Wilson score 95%, descriptive and independence-assuming; not valid cluster-adjusted uncertainty under shared templates.

cluster.sampling: Within each frozen expected-action class (draft, attachment, abstain), sample the same number of whole families with replacement; sum metric numerators/denominators across all sampled families, including false positive offers in abstain families.
cluster.quantiles: Nearest rank at 0.025 and 0.975 over defined ratios. Report undefined replicate count and defined count; all undefined yields null interval. Any omitted undefined replicates make the interval conditional and explicitly qualified.
cluster.limitations: Only five held-out families per class: exploratory and poorly estimated, not a robust population interval or safety guarantee. Point-estimate gates unchanged.

gateStatistic: point estimate; intervals reported, no post-hoc change to lower-bound gating
equivalence: Exact JSON values for required fields after normalizing CRLF to LF and Unicode NFC in strings; no trimming, case folding, semantic matching or model-as-judge. Target IDs exact. Extra executable actions are false positives.
multiLabel: Every expected action must match an unused offered action; each offered action counts once. Routing precision is per offered action, recall per expected action. Required-field correctness requires every required field in a matched draft action. No predictions may be chosen after results are seen. Matching uses two passes: exact required-field+route matches first, then route-only matches, consuming labels and offers once. Expected labels and offers retain their recorded order within each pass.
failures: Generic provider error, timeout, malformed output, budget refusal and missing prediction remain failures in intended-run recall and abstention denominators. Explicit structural rejection may count ONLY under structuralAbstention below. Report model-only and deterministic-fault results separately; never attribute structural rejection to model quality.
exclusions: Only cases marked unsupported in the frozen manifest are excluded from actionable recall. They must carry abstain labels and remain in abstention/safety metrics. No post-result exclusions.
safety: Report observed authority violations, unauthorized disclosures, duplicate effects and automatic effects; any observed event fails. Missing safety observations make acceptance unknown, never zero. Automation always disabled.
reporting: Provider/model/action strata, exact counts, media and group coverage, supported-case abstention, correction effort, nearest-rank p50/p95 latency, trustworthy actual charge separately from retained conservative reservations, provider failure/fallback rates. Missing usage/confidence is unknown.
freeze: Hash protocol, corpus manifest and every source byte before provider prompt fitting or held-out evaluation. Record immutable run profile and prompt/catalog/policy/provider/package versions. Revisions require new version and cannot reuse opened held-out cases as unseen evidence.
limitations: Synthetic domain only; authored synthetic speech and distorted synthetic raster documents are not human recordings or camera photographs. Case-level intervals do not establish independent-group uncertainty or deployment safety. No automatic execution claim is permitted. Primary uncertainty is the observed variation across originating families; no confidence level is claimed for that exact finite-corpus summary.

structuralAbstention.scope: End-to-end system abstention for a frozen expected corrupt_source or unsupported_type case only. Generic failure is never enough.
structuralAbstention.verification: Trusted runner re-reads authoritative owning service state/provenance and confirms the specific structural reason and no eligible proposal/action. If the public owning API only exposes generic provider_failure/malformed_output, record failure/unknown, not structural success.
structuralAbstention.reporting: System abstention gate remains95%. Separately report model abstention for model-eligible cases, explicit no-model-call coverage and deterministic fault outcomes. No paid-provider quality claim from injected responses.

predictionProjection.routingAndFields: Count every validated offered suggestion, including needs_review; retain order and raw provider response. Only ready_for_review suggestions may enter separately authenticated human review/effect verification.
predictionProjection.abstention: Requires an explicit valid zero-suggestion no_action/unknown/ambiguous model response plus matching persisted zero-suggestion disposition; pipeline-produced unknown, no supported catalog, provider failure, removed/omitted suggestions, and unresolved empty output do not count.
predictionProjection.identifiers: Freeze exact logical-to-owning UUID bijection before provider I/O. Use it for scoring only; source bytes, candidate titles and actual owning catalog UUIDs are unchanged. Unknown output IDs remain unmatched false-positive offers, never fuzzy mapped or treated as abstention.
predictionProjection.completion: SDK-normalized completion is unknown (SDK issue1381); warnings retained, human review permitted, automatic eligibility always false.
predictionProjection.databases: Measure heldout once on isolated sequential SQLite reference hosts. Prove representative complete flow parity on PostgreSQL without duplicating paid heldout inference.
predictionProjection.reviewer: Scripted authenticated reviewer under agent-authored preregistered oracle; not observed human correction sessions. Real human elapsed review time unmeasured.
predictionProjection.scriptedReviewPolicy: After raw scoring, the authenticated scripted reviewer approves only exact remaining frozen expected action/required-field matches, consuming each expected action once; other reviewable offers are rejected. No oracle values enter provider input. Effects/replay/reload are recorded separately; rejected/corrected outputs never improve raw scores.
predictionProjection.latency: Primary latency runs from maintained upload entry through persisted suggestion reload; excludes deployment migration and authored candidate fixture setup. Scripted review/effect duration is separate and is not measured human review time.

transportIdentity: Internal case/group identifiers never enter capture metadata. Capture ID is SHA256 of domain-separated evaluation-capture-v1 plus case ID; filename is generic source plus format extension. Internal hash-bound capture-identity artifact retains exact mapping. Original source text and deliberate document titles remain unchanged and may contain simplified authored semantic cues; these limit generalization.
